acceptanceCriteria: Batch-check accepts a retroactive binding with a focused test.
body:
Source: wave-6 lane report (2026-10-11).

Observed: dogfood batch-check does not support retroactive bindings.

Expected: retroactive bindings are supported with explicit evidence.

Acceptance: batch-check accepts a retroactive binding with a focused test.
title: Support retroactive bindings in dogfood batch-check
